title: GeTe: ferroelectric double well, shear-strain coupling and its collapse under pressure (PBE)

decision_points.fork: Which energy difference is the well depth
decision_points.wrong_choice: Scan x at the rocksalt cell (alpha = 60 deg, cubic a0) and call that double well the well depth
decision_points.consequence: The clamped depth (18.4 meV/f.u.) is 42 % below the relaxed 31.9 meV/f.u.: the shear and volume relaxation supply 42 % of the depth

decision_points.fork: Volume reference of the two phases
decision_points.wrong_choice: Compare rocksalt and R3m at the same volume (rocksalt at the R3m volume), or relax only x in the experimental cell
decision_points.consequence: PBE R3m is 3.6 % larger in volume than rocksalt: rocksalt at the R3m volume gives 41.6 meV/f.u. (+31 %); relaxing x only in the experimental cell (a 2 GPa compressed cell in PBE) gives 15.6 meV/f.u. and alpha/x/a that are the experimental values, not the protocol ones

decision_points.kind: discovered evidence (k convergence of a small-gap phase)
decision_points.fork: k mesh for the rocksalt energy
decision_points.wrong_choice: A 12x12x12 mesh for both phases (enough for the R3m pressure and structure)
decision_points.consequence: Rocksalt has only a 0.35 eV gap at L: its energy is 1.4 meV too high at k12 (0.4 at k16, 0.1 at k20 vs k24) while R3m is 0.55 meV too low: depth +6.1 %, clamped depth +8.6 %

decision_points.fork: How the R3m stationary point is located
decision_points.wrong_choice: Quadratic model through one-sided steps from the starting guess, minimum taken from the model without a check at the predicted point
decision_points.consequence: The surface is anharmonic over the 0.03 A / 0.4 deg / 0.005 steps; the one-sided model minimum is off by +0.008 A, -0.15 deg, -0.001 in x (outside the structure windows); a centred stencil plus a Newton step at the predicted point lands within 0.009 deg

decision_points.fork: Per formula unit vs per atom
decision_points.wrong_choice: Energies per atom of the two-atom cell

decision_points.fork: Occupations for the compressed rocksalt phase
decision_points.wrong_choice: Keep the fixed occupations that are valid at zero pressure (insulator, 0.35 eV gap)
decision_points.consequence: The gap at L closes between 3 and 7 GPa (band edges on the mesh show it); with fixed occupations on k16 the soft-mode zero crossing moves to 9.9 GPa (+1.3 GPa)

decision_points.kind: convergence that matters only near the boundary
decision_points.fork: Mesh and smearing for the soft-mode force constant of the semimetal
decision_points.wrong_choice: k12 with MV 0.01 Ry (adequate for the zero-pressure energies)
decision_points.consequence: k12 with MV 0.01 Ry puts the critical pressure at 9.6 GPa (+1.07 GPa)

decision_points.fork: Displacement used for the harmonic force constant
decision_points.wrong_choice: A large displacement (x = 0.48) whose force contains the quartic term
decision_points.consequence: At x = 0.48 the force contains the quartic term: the apparent force constant is positive at every pressure from 7.4 GPa up, and extrapolating it to zero gives 1.5 GPa instead of 8.6 GPa

decision_points.fork: How the spin-orbit effect is isolated
decision_points.wrong_choice: Compare the fully relativistic PSlibrary result with the SSSP (scalar) result
decision_points.consequence: The SSSP (Ge 3d in valence) vs PSlibrary (3d frozen) difference cancels the true +1.46 meV/f.u. spin-orbit change: the mixed comparison gives +0.06 meV/f.u.

length_estimate.oracle_compute_minutes: ~75 (sum of construction wall times of its requests on 2 loaded cores)
length_estimate.tool_calls: 45-80 (20-35 evaluations: rocksalt pressures, R3m stencil or scan with gradients, k ladders of both phases, clamped scan, soft-mode series under pressure with occupation/mesh checks, spin-orbit pair; each 0.5-9 minute job followed by 1-4 polls)

runtime_dependencies: Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x and OpenMPI from the runtime image (lab only)
numpy 1.21.5 from the runtime image (lab charge counter, oracle)

data_provenance.paired_study: Dangic, Fahy, Savic, GAP for GeTe, Materials Cloud x2tdq-3bt13 (doi:10.24435/materialscloud:pd-g9), npj Comput. Mater. 2021 (question-level pairing only; no file used)

notes: Deviations from the candidate design: (1) the lab offers SCF calculations only (energies, full stress and forces); relaxations were dropped after a vc-relax took >25 min on 2 cores, and the R3m minimum is found from stress/force gradients. (2) The pressure question is graded as the harmonic soft-mode instability pressure of rocksalt (8.6 GPa), where the polar force constant changes sign; the compressed rocksalt phase is a semimetal there. Whether the relaxed transition is continuous is a rubric item only. (3) No hidden validation SCFs (the lab could compute them directly). (4) Spin-orbit added as a graded fork (PSlibrary scalar vs fully relativistic pair; the SSSP protocol is scalar-relativistic). (5) Polarization (Born charges / Berry phase) not offered. (6) Requests capped at 8 units (<= ~9 min); the densest reference runs (k24 polar, k16 spin-orbit R3m) exceed the cap and are construction-only convergence anchors; reachable routes (k20, k12 spin-orbit) are robustness variants inside the windows.
